grenadier.name: Grenadier
grenadier.html:
The quest can be completed in several ways:
Method against Scavs.

Take a couple or three of any fragmentation grenades into the raid and head to any convenient location. We recommend Customs.

As soon as you find a Scav or a group of Scavs, you can kill everyone except one, or cripple the legs of all Scavs with your primary weapon (1-2 shots to one leg will prevent the Scav from running away).
Then prepare a grenade and throw it with LMB (far) or RMB (lobbed from above downward, close) under the Scav's feet. If the Scav is moving away, throw slightly ahead — to lead the target.

Try not to throw along the road — the grenade will roll too far.

Tripwires are ineffective against bots.

=

Method against PMCs.
Find in Grenade box

RGO hand grenade
or
RGN hand grenade
. These are impact grenades that explode after a 0.3-second delay upon contact with a surface. A "foolproof" mechanism applies; these grenades explode at a distance of five meters. If you don't know how these grenades work, test them in offline mode. Head to Factory. Take the grenade in your hands, pull the pin, and wait for the enemy in a narrow corridor.
It is best to look for grenades on these locations:

On the Reserve map
On the Lighthouse map
On Streets of Tarkov

=

Another method: using

Tripwire installation kit
. Place a tripwire in hard-to-pass or dark places. It is best to use
VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenade
since this grenade has the shortest trigger time.

You can place them in bushes, on staircases, in crossings. You need to understand that the place where you place it is not for running. You can only move there on foot. A tripwire + VOG costs approximately 65,000 rubles.

=

Kills with

Milkor M32A1 MSGL 40mm grenade launcher
,
GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher
, and
M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher
do not count.

the-survivalist-path-unprotected-but-dan.name: The Survivalist Path - Unprotected but Dangerous
the-survivalist-path-unprotected-but-dan.html:
Take any weapon and head to any map.

You need to kill 5 PMCs without armor on any map.

 

Walkthrough options:

Cheap, long, relatively safe — take a bolt-action rifle with a scope, go to Woods or Shoreline. Pick off PMCs from bushes or from a distance. Do not wear armor. Take a pistol for killing Scavs.

 

Cheap but fast, if you have instant grenades like

RGO hand grenade
— go into a Factory raid with nothing, run to the office or nearest PMC spawns Find PMC spawns on Factory . Run to the enemy and throw a grenade at them. Practice the throw in offline mode.

 

Powerful: Take excellent weaponry and go into a raid on any map without armor. Better to go to Customs, where the distance is medium. Shoot PMCs in passages and approaches to the dorms.

You will eventually complete this task.

Extract from the raid alive.

the-survivalist-path-tough-guy.html:
Take any weapon with an optical sight and go to the Woods location. Choose any position where Scavs spawn and stay put to minimize the risk of taking damage.

 

You are not allowed to use any medical items. No medkits, no splints, no painkillers, etc.

 

Even after killing three Scavs, do not use any medicine — the quest will fail.

 

If you kill three Scavs in a single raid without using medicine but die afterward, the quest will not fail.

and
Army crackers
work best. Also bring
Bottle of water (0.6L)
.

 

Consume the food, wait about 30 seconds until the screen starts to blur and the pain shock effect appears, then kill Scavs. Once enough Scavs are killed, drink the water.

 

Do not use medical items that provide pain relief (e.g.

Analgin painkillers
), as they will remove the pain shock effect and Scav kills will not count.

 

It is recommended to complete this quest on the Woods location.

health-care-privacy-part-4.name: Health Care Privacy - Part 4
health-care-privacy-part-4.html:
Under the new conditions, you need to get the "Fatigue" status and maintain it for 8 minutes.

 

Fatigue is a state where your energy (food) is drained faster.

 

ATTENTION! There are two types of "Fatigue" in the game:
- When your energy runs out completely and your health starts to drop — that is fatigue.
- When you deplete your stamina bar multiple times (or for a long time) in a short period — that is also "Fatigue". You need this version.

 

Updated and verified!

 

Take food and drink with you.

2 ways to complete it:

 

Option 1: Go into a raid, hide in a secluded spot where no one will find you. Run and jump until your stamina runs out. As soon as your stamina is depleted, switch to crouch movement.

Move while crouched or stand in this mode so that your stamina DOES NOT REGENERATE. Make sure your stamina does not enter the green zone — this is important.

 

Option 2: Again, go into a raid and hide away from possible enemies. In the game controls settings, make sure "Aim" is set to "Hold" mode. Stand in a hidden spot and press Aim — your character will raise their weapon and their arm stamina will drain. After arm stamina, leg stamina (total endurance, the lower bar) will start draining.

 

A lightning bolt icon will appear in the top left — the fatigue icon. It is beige. When this icon appears, the fatigue effect will gradually build up — keep moving or standing without regenerating stamina. It takes about 1 minute. If you've done everything correctly, open your inventory — the "Health" tab. Hover your cursor over the fatigue icon and check the timer in seconds. You need to have more than 480 seconds.

hell-on-earth-2.name: Hell on Earth - Part 2
hell-on-earth-2.html:
To complete the task, you need to eliminate three cultists using

MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun
. Prapor will provide the initial one; if lost, buy it yourself. Recommended ammo is
12/70 8.5mm Magnum buckshot
, aim only for the head.

 

Cultists only appear at night on the following maps: Shoreline, Woods, Customs, Factory (Nighttime), and Ground Zero (after level 20). From approximately 23:00 to 06:00.

 

Spawn chance is higher on Shoreline, Woods, and Customs. On Factory and Ground Zero they are almost impossible to find. Cultists are a boss. A group consists of four cultists and the leader Priest. At sunrise they despawn (disappear). Other bosses can prevent Cultists from spawning (for example, if Reshala spawns at construction, Cultists won’t appear until Reshala and his guards are fully eliminated).

 

They usually sit or lie in bushes waiting for someone to approach. They first attack with a knife, but if you shoot them first or kill their leader, they immediately open fire. If you kill the entire group, the Priest may try to blow himself up with a grenade.

 

On the Customs map, you can kill them by holding the sarcophagus building. It’s very convenient to use cover inside. One advantage is that they will sometimes push you indoors.

 

At long range, there’s little point engaging them without a thermal scope (they are visible through thermal optics).

 

On Shoreline, it is recommended to kill them near the hydroelectric station. Just climb the nearby hill and shoot them from above. Keep more than 100 meters away from them.
You can also try to kill them at the sanatorium. Sometimes they appear inside on the first floor and outside, except for the admin building. They can also be found at the flooded village.

 

The Woods location is highly discouraged for killing Cultists. Large open spaces, bushes, and trees make it nearly impossible to fight them effectively.

 

On the Factory map, they appear in all locations where Scavs can spawn. They can be in the basement or offices. If Cultists are in the raid, Scavs will not spawn.

 

On the Ground Zero map, they appear opposite the Terragroup building.

iron-authority.name: Indisputable Authority
iron-authority.html:
Shadow of Tagilla, Vengeful Killa Guide to fighting the Labyrinth Bosses ... 17.10.26

The "Minotaur" himself is Tagilla, who has a special axe. He is very strong and has powerful class 6 armor — chest and helmet. He is located in the center of the The Labyrinth map.

After the "Minotaur," Killa will appear — he is also strong and will avenge him.

You have two options:

Take the most armor-piercing ammunition and shoot around the head.

Or take good ammunition and shoot at the legs, or hope to penetrate the helmet.

Shoot from around a corner, do not push him. When the boss runs at you, back away — he will instantly kill you in close combat.

The Boss's retinue consists of Rogues with ancient names. They are fairly weak but will interfere. Killing them is not difficult, but if there are other PMCs in the raid with you, you will not complete this quest on the first try.

clear-the-room.html:
Put on your best gear and weapons — you're heading into the Labyrinth.

Don't forget to bring a Keycard for entry and a multitool.

There are few players in the Labyrinth, and those who are there often wait until the very end — to kill the remaining PMCs and take everything for themselves. Be extremely careful.
If you're playing in a group, there will be fewer enemies. The Labyrinth allows up to 5 players — friends or foes, it doesn't matter. Maximum 5 players total.
If you're in a full group, all 5 allies will spawn together without enemy PMCs.
Stock up on keycards in advance.

the-guide.name: The Guide
the-guide.html:
You need to obtain the "Survived" status on the specified locations without dying, and kill 15 any targets on any locations.

Input data:

You need to gain at least 600 experience before extracting from a location, or stay in the raid for at least 7 minutes.

For example, kill three Scavs and loot them / loot a lot / kill a PMC with many items.
It is recommended to kill three Scavs each, loot them, and leave the location. It is recommended to complete the quest at night. The chance of encountering an opponent will be lower.

When completing this quest, it is desirable to have a Library in your hideout, as it gives a % of additional experience in raid.

You can complete the maps in any order. If you are in danger, you can leave the map at any time using an exit or transition, even if you have the "sprint" status. Any subtasks can be completed while you are alive in your current life.

You can kill 15 targets on ANY maps, even if survival is not required there. It is important not to die.

After completing the quest, you MUST TURN IT IN IMMEDIATELY. Otherwise, it will fail after your death.

============

Recommendations for choosing maps and standard walkthrough:

Enter the specified location. Run as usual or sit to accumulate experience. Take money with you,

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Green)
, as well as
Red Rebel ice pick
and
Paracord
. To avoid dropping armor for climbing through the Ice Axe, take an armored rig. We also recommend taking NVGs.

Wait for the timer and simultaneously try to kill a few Scavs.

Maps (in order of subtasks):
Woods or Interchange — Woods. This is a large location; hiding behind bushes and trees will make you hard to find, and due to the map's scale, encountering an opponent will be more difficult. If you find it hard to navigate in Woods, choose Interchange.

Customs or Factory — Customs. Here it will be easier for you to survive. On Factory, anything can happen; it's a small location.

Shoreline or Reserve — we recommend Shoreline. Reserve is very difficult for extraction, but you can use transitions. On Shoreline, there is always an exit to Lighthouse or a central exit through the Ice Axe.

Laboratory or Lighthouse — definitely Lighthouse. Laboratory is a high-level map; the chance of dying here is extremely high.

Ground Zero or Streets of Tarkov — depending on the game mode. Currently in PvP Season, on both maps, there is a chance to encounter a Black Division squad. But on Epicenter, the concentration of opponents and their level will be higher — players farm these units. Choose Streets of Tarkov.

============
You can literally transition to the next location and onward 1 minute after the raid starts. All locations you visit will be counted if you survived and gained more than 600 experience.

The strategy is: Go to empty servers (choose either those with the highest ping or those where the audience is currently "asleep"), gear up for the raid with the best you have, but without a backpack (extra weight, plus visibility). It is important to take a helmet with a face shield so a random Scav doesn't shoot you in the eyes. Be sure to take some food. If you want to try to complete everything in one go, you need to take

TerraGroup Labs access keycard
. Also take 30,000 rubles for various situations, for example, for the BTR or a vehicle exit from a location.

Route No. 1 for a one-time completion:

Laboratory — Streets of Tarkov — Interchange — Customs — Shoreline

from Laboratory to Streets of Tarkov
from Streets to Interchange
from Interchange to Customs
from Customs to Shoreline

At any moment, you can leave the location by any usual method if needed. The locations where you survived will be counted. And then complete the remaining locations and kill targets the old-fashioned way.

============

Route No. 2. Partially with transitions, safer:
Factory — Woods — Lighthouse — Shoreline. Exit the map and go to Streets of Tarkov or Epicenter — your choice.
from Factory to Woods
from Woods to Lighthouse
from Lighthouse to Shoreline

At any moment, you can leave the location by any usual method if needed. The locations where you survived will be counted. And then complete the remaining locations the old-fashioned way.

===

Buy any bolt-action rifle and head to Factory.

After loading in, if you spawn near a Scav spawn point, you might want to wait 1–2 minutes for the first waves of bots to appear.

the-art-of-demolitions.html:
You need to kill 20 PMCs using explosives.

Grenades and launchers, including underbarrel ones, will work.

GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher

— place them in passages or on staircases.

 

Can be completed in a group.

For safety, we recommend going to empty servers or running around Scav spawn points throughout the raid.

 

The point with the largest number of bots on Shoreline is Azure Coast Health Resort .

the-punisher-part-6.name: The Punisher - Part 6
the-punisher-part-6.html:
Take the weapon used in previous parts of this quest chain. You need to kill 30 PMCs.

These are

KBP VSK-94 9x39 rifle
or
KBP 9A-91 9x39 compact assault rifle
,
SVDS 7.62x54R sniper rifle
or
TKPD 9.3x64 carbine Assault
,
Kalashnikov AKS-74U 5.45x39 assault rifle
,
Kalashnikov AKM 7.62x39 assault rifle
.

Also LMGs.

 

Maps to complete this: Epicenter, Laboratory, Lighthouse, Shoreline, or Reserve.

We recommend Epicenter and Reserve — higher PMC density and more convenient.

 

You also need to collect 10 PMC dog tags.

 

And you also need to kill 5 Bosses.

The easiest recommendation is Reshala.

 

There is a note in the quest — do not go to Factory, as the quest might fail there.

samples.name: Samples
samples.html:
The best way to complete this quest is to buy

TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
on the flea market. Then take
TerraGroup Labs access keycard
, go to The Lab, and enter the experiment room. All required stimulants can spawn on the floor, chairs, boxes, and examination couches.

 

You can complete quest A Difficult Choice to receive

TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
as a reward for access to the lab room. This quest also requires finding stimulants, but it’s easier to complete. If you can't complete it, do Gunsmith Master - Part 13 to trade with Mechanic for the black keycard.

 

Less reliable methods to find stimulants: in the backpacks of Sanitar and his guards; from Scav players (or playing as a Scav); use

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)
on an open map and hope for a medical airdrop; or wait for your Scav to spawn with the required syringe in inventory.

 

These were general tips. Now let’s go over each stimulant:

M.U.L.E. stimulant injector
,
3-(b-TG) stimulant injector
,
Meldonin injector
: on Lighthouse, behind the Rogues’ base lab in container , medical bags.

Obdolbos cocktail injector
: Medical locations in Woods : EMERCOM, USEC camp, covered hangar at the lumber mill

AHF1-M stimulant injector
: many players struggle with this stimulant. Sadly, it has no fixed spawn. See the general tips above.

P22 (Product 22) stimulant injector
: reward from quest Tarkov-Style Diplomacy

L1 (Norepinephrine) injector
: Tagilla, useful spots on Lighthouse , lab on Lighthouse

Quest walkthrough:
This quest is best completed on the Lighthouse map.
At Lighthouse, go to the Rogues’ base and eliminate Rogues or Scavs either from the hills on the right side of the base or from the shoreline, ensuring the range is over 100 meters using a rangefinder.

and

.

and

silent-caliber.html:
Buy any 12-gauge shotgun, attach a suppressor to it, and go kill enemies on Reserve, Lighthouse, Epicenter, or Laboratory.

We recommend choosing Epicenter or Reserve as the most suitable locations with a large number of enemies — Scavs.

You can kill any targets, totaling 30.

Can be completed in a group.

 

A budget build would be an MP-153 with a suppressor, scope, and extended magazine.

If you have plenty of money, you can mod a Saiga, but it won't make much difference.

MP-153 with a silencer

psycho-sniper.name: Psycho Sniper
psycho-sniper.html:
Completing this quest unlocks Shooter Born in Heaven.

 

In the updated quest, the task has been significantly simplified for you.

You only need to eliminate ANY 15 targets in a single life on any location.

 

ATTENTION!

Information that worked previously: if you couldn't kill the required number in one raid, you could simply extract alive and re-enter. The counter would not reset.

Alternatively, you could transition to a neighboring location and continue killing there.

 

We recommend taking a sniper rifle that suits you, purchasable ammunition — and plenty of it — along with an optical scope, and heading to the Woods map. If you're confident there are few or no players on your map, take only the bolt-action rifle. If you're afraid of other PMCs, take an assault rifle +

Marlin MXLR .308 ME lever-action rifle

 

Recommended gear:

Class 5 armor, for example

NPP KlASS Korund-VM body armor (Black)
, a class 4 helmet (preferably with a face shield to protect against a stray bullet/shot to the head), and headphones.

 

Best maps with many Scavs that are easy to kill (any body part):

Woods — long range, easy to kill from a safe distance. Plenty of space for a raid.

Interchange — close-range map, ideal for the Marlin, but the Killa boss can be a major obstacle. Recommended only for experienced players.

Customs — the golden standard for completing any quests.

Shoreline — a good medium-range map. The resort and its surroundings are full of Scavs.

collector.name: Collector
collector.html:
Updated to patch 1.1 in EFT. New items added.

 

To gain access, you need to reach loyalty level 4 with all Traders — this can be done by completing their tasks at each loyalty level and accumulating reputation. Any tasks that give reputation will work.

Complete the required number of quests — raise your reputation and start doing tasks of the next level — they give more reputation.

 

Fence loyalty level 3 — can be increased by using paid exits on PMC (cars on maps), successful Scav extractions, killing PMCs as a Scav, co-op extracts — as a PMC, find a Scav and extract together at special exits, or do the same as a Scav.

 

You also need to complete the quest chains up to and including the specified quests. That is, you don't need to go beyond The Tarkov Shooter - Part 4.

Chemical - Part 4, Shooter Born in Heaven, The Tarkov Shooter - Part 4, Sew it Good - Part 2

 

You need to find in raid items added to the game in honor of streamers.

 

Below is information on where to find some of the items:

Worn antique book, raven figurine, Veritas pick, Viibiin brand sneakers, Tamatthi kunai knife replica: Safes

#FireKlean weapon lubricant, Inseq pipe wrench: Tech supply crates

 

Silver dog tag: Laboratory – Security Arsenal (Red keycard), Manager's office, safes

 

Deadlyslob beard oil: Interchange – Power substation, OLI offices, information desk opposite IDEA

 

Golden 1Gphone: Interchange – electronics stores, power substation

 

Dr. Lupo's grain coffee can, English tea – Food crates, Jaeger stashes, bags

 

Pestily mask, Shroud half-mask, Antique axe, Fake mustache, Kotton cap – Scav case (send moonshine), Scavs, Rogues

 

Armband (Evasion)
can be found in Duffle bag, Jacket, Ground cache, Buried barrel cache

 

NutSack balaclava – spawns on Scavs and in Duffle bag

 

Mazoni dumbbell – spawns in valuable loot spots, in Duffle bag, and random locations

 

Tigzresq tire – appears in medical spawns and on Scavs. Most often on Scavs, but not with full durability

 

Domonotovich cap – spawns on Scavs. Very rarely in Duffle bag

escort.name: Escort
escort.html:
You need to eliminate 2 PMCs on multiple maps without dying.

 

It’s recommended to start with The Lab, Factory (Daytime), and Ground Zero, as these are small maps with high PvP activity.

 

Playing in a group is a viable tactic — trade teammates for information if needed.

 

The Lab: Most fights happen near keycard-locked rooms.
Factory: Encounters usually occur in offices and basements.
Ground Zero: Players are often found in the Terragroup building.
Shoreline: Focus on the Health Resort and Norvinsk yacht club.
Woods: Many beginners spawn early near the EMERCOM camp and USEC base.
Interchange: Players loot electronics stores early on; some head for the no-backpack extract.
Reserve: PMCs often camp the D-2 lever room and the extract itself.
Customs: Common PMC locations include dorms, the library, and the construction site where Reshala spawns.

 

If a gunfight happens indoors or at close range, peek from your right side. The more rotations you make around the map, the higher your chances of running into bush campers. The more sub-objectives you've completed, the more passively you should play.

 

Below are PMC spawn maps — helpful if you decide to play aggressively and intercept players early in the raid:

You need to find or buy two types of armor vests, two of each.

You can buy them on the Flea Market.

Vests can be handed in without plates.

This vest can also be found on Reshala's guards on Customs.

This information has not yet been verified, but you can most likely also hand in side plates. For example, if you find

To carry more plates out in one raid, we recommend taking off your own armor and equipping the one found in raid, while collecting additional plates by removing them from other vests and placing them in your backpack.

test-drive-part-1.name: The Tarkov Import

Take the modified

You can complete this task in a group.

You need to go to the Reserve or Lighthouse location.

Reserve will be easier, as it is a more PvP-friendly map.

Kill PMCs at any distance. If you plan to run through the basements, attach a flashlight to your build — it will be useful.

a-shooter-born-in-heaven.name: Shooter Born in Heaven
a-shooter-born-in-heaven.html:
The quest unlocks after completing Psycho Sniper.

 

To complete the task, take any bolt-action sniper rifle of your choice (Mosin, SV-98, DVL-10, Remington M700, T-5000M ORSIS, VPO-215 "Gornostay", AMXC) and go kill PMCs with headshots.

In patch 1.0, the lever-action rifle

Marlin MXLR .308 ME lever-action rifle
was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing this task.

 

Since distance does not matter, you can wait at any crowded or quest-related positions (ideally, quests involving item planting, where the target is stationary), or, if skilled enough, engage in close combat.

 

For each subtask, you can kill 5 PMCs on either of the two locations. In total, you need to kill 20.

Customs or Lighthouse — We recommend Customs.

Streets of Tarkov or Shoreline — Shoreline.

Interchange or Ground Zero — Ground Zero.

Woods or Reserve — Woods.

setup.html:

These are simple weapons (you can modify them however you like).

 

Verified list of suitable weapons:

or, as a last resort,

huntsman-path-eraser.name: The Huntsman Path - Eraser
huntsman-path-eraser.html:
The boss Glukhar resides on the Reserve location and is accompanied by six well-armed guards.

 

They have heavy armor and high health, so killing him will require a lot of high-penetration ammo.

 

You’re lucky if you encounter him in the barracks (Black Pawn) or the school building (Black Bishop). The easiest way to kill him is at close range in narrow corridors by camping in one of the rooms.

 

If you run into him near the technical repair points (Knight), it’s best to approach from behind the buildings to avoid stepping into open ground.

 

The worst case is encountering him at the unloading station near the depot (K). It’s the most inconvenient place to kill the boss. There are many angles he can shoot through. You can try using the AGS mounted on one of the bunkers (E2).

 

The boss can also spawn in the underground areas near the path leading to the hermetic bunker door.

 

The closer you get to Glukhar, the higher your chances of killing him. If he spots you from a distance, you’ll have no chance.

hunting-trip.name: Hunting Trip
hunting-trip.html:
You must kill 20 Bosses using bolt-action rifles.

Distance does not matter, nor does the hit location.

You can kill the same Boss multiple times.

 

This can be combined with Shooter Born in Heaven — run around the map in search of a Boss while also killing PMCs.

 

Almost every map has its own Boss.

If you are a beginner, we recommend:

Woods — an open location with plenty of opportunities to take out Shturman from a distance.

Find the Boss on the Woods map

Customs — more difficult due to closed spaces, but you can run with a collimator sight — Reshala is one of the weakest Bosses, but has a strong squad.

Find the Boss on the Customs map

Shoreline — there is a chance Sanitar will be at the cottages, where you can kill him from a distance with a headshot.

Find the Boss on the Shoreline map

 

The above options can only be done with a bolt-action rifle. Below, we recommend completing with both a primary weapon and a bolt-action.

 

If you are a more experienced player, we recommend:

Streets of Tarkov — this map has two Bosses. More chances, but due to low FPS and close combat, it will be difficult.

Find the Boss on the Streets of Tarkov map

Reserve — the Boss is often in open areas, but shoots extremely accurately from a distance.

Find the Boss on the Reserve map

 

The following may also count: Rogue Bosses, Black Division, Partisan, Tagilla and Killa from the Labyrinth.

huntsman-path-factory-chief.html:
The boss Tagilla spawns with a certain chance on the Factory location.

 

It’s best to complete the quest with a friend — Tagilla chases him with a sledgehammer, allowing you to shoot him in the unprotected back of the head.

 

The boss is very aggressive and starts shooting immediately. The best tactic is to get as close as possible so that he switches to the sledgehammer and starts chasing you.

 

Since the boss wears class 4 and 6 armor, it’s best to use high-penetration, high-damage ammo.

 

His only protected areas are the head (excluding the back) and chest, so you can try to kill him with buckshot to the stomach or legs (be careful — Tagilla ignores broken legs and will continue to chase you even after multiple shots to them).

spawns on the boss with a 100% chance. If you kill the boss but can’t extract the cap, try checking Scav players — one might have it.

night-sweep.name: Night Sweep
night-sweep.html:
Cultists Cultists and Priest guide ... 04.07.22

Cultist knife
drops only from Cultists, but it may not drop at all. Cultists appear only at night on the locations: Shoreline, Woods, Customs, Factory (Night time), and Ground Zero (after character level 20). Approximately from 23:00 to 6:00.
===

Knives can be bought on the Flea Market and handed over for the quest. They do not need to be found "in raid."

If the Flea Market is unavailable, you can find the cultists, kill them, and take their knives into your SECURE CONTAINER. There, if you die, you won't lose it and can hand it over.

If you place the knife in the melee weapon slot, it will disappear if you die.

===

On the locations Shoreline, Woods, and Customs, the spawn chance is higher. On the locations Factory and Ground Zero, they are almost impossible to encounter. Cultists are a boss. In a group, there are four cultists and a leader, the Priest. When morning comes, they despawn (disappear). Other bosses can prevent Cultists from appearing (For example, boss Reshala appeared at the construction site. Cultists will not appear until boss Reshala and his guards are completely killed).

Usually they sit/lie in bushes and wait for someone to approach them. They attack with a knife first, but if you start shooting at them first or kill their leader, they will immediately start shooting. If you kill the entire retinue, the Priest may try to blow himself up with a grenade.
===
On the location Customs, you can kill them by taking the sarcophagus. It is very convenient to play from cover inside this room. An advantage is that they will sometimes push you inside the building.

At long distances without a thermal scope, there is little point in engaging them (their silhouettes are visible in thermal scopes).

===

On the location Shoreline, it is recommended to kill them at the hydroelectric station. It is enough to climb the hill next to them and shoot them from above. Keep a distance of more than one hundred meters from them.
You can also try killing them in the health resort. It happens that they appear inside the health resort on the first floor and outside, excluding the administrative building. They can also be found near the flooded village.

===

The Woods location is highly not recommended for killing Cultists. Large open spaces, bushes, and trees will not allow you to successfully shoot it out with them.

===

On the location Factory, they appear in all places where Scavs can appear. They can be both in the basements and in the offices. If Cultists are in the raid, Scavs will not appear.

===

On the location Ground Zero, they inhabit the area opposite the Terragroup building.
===

the-huntsman-path-big-game.name: The Huntsman Path - Big Game
the-huntsman-path-big-game.html:
The boss Kaban is not the most difficult boss in the game, but he has his own features.

The main feature is that he has only one spawn point – inside the LEXOS car dealership.

It’s a small fortress with machine guns and an automatic grenade launcher. He has a squad of strong NPCs and assistants. All are well-equipped and have lots of health.

Snipers are often on the roof! The roof is on the left, right, and the bridge between roofs.

Machine guns are aimed at the gate, so you can't just walk in. You either need to kill the gunners or throw a grenade — to kill them or force them to flee.

The best way to enter the LEXOS area is to throw a grenade toward the gunner. This way you either kill or scare them off and can rush in to take position.

If you enter from Chekannaya Street, we recommend taking position to the left of the entrance inside the container. From there, you can carefully aim and kill the Boss’s guards or Scavs. BEWARE OF THE MACHINE GUN. Bots will try to sit behind it to shoot. You can shoot them while they run for it.

If you enter from Scout Street, run to the right into the small building.

The boss Kaban himself is found inside the building on the left (LEXOS sales office) or right (garage box). Sometimes, he can be outside. Killing him isn’t very hard, but often he shoots at you “seeing” through walls. The easiest way to kill him is while he’s running — either toward you or from a grenade. It takes a lot of bullets to kill him, but he’s simple overall.

His corpse contains 100-round machine gun magazines and keys to the second floor of LEXOS — one of them is single-use, needed for future quests.

huntsman-path-crooked-cop.name: The Huntsman Path - Crooked Cop
huntsman-path-crooked-cop.html:
Kollontay is one of the bosses on the Streets of Tarkov map.
His locations are the MVD Academy or Klimov Trading House.
Find on the map
Kollontay is often found sitting inside the mentioned buildings and attacks players through windows while his guards push the target.
His guards are four bots, have Raider AI, and act as assault units. They may wear armor and helmets up to class 5, but their visors are usually no higher than class 3.
Kollontay himself has 300 health in the torso and 65 in the head, so it's recommended to eliminate him with precise headshots. His only head protection is a firefighter helmet with level 2 armor, so there shouldn't be any issues penetrating it with most mid-tier rounds.
Beware of close combat with Kollontay because of the "Panic" effect he can apply to the player while using his police baton. This effect will cause your current weapon to jam.

You must have time to exit the BTR, run here, pick up the battery (if it spawns), inject the stimulants listed below, and have time to run back to the BTR before it drives away and hand it over. war-war-never-changes.name: War... war never changes
war-war-never-changes.html:
The quest unlocks after completing Boreas at the point of killing the Wedge bosses and finding the ship's captain.


Open the server room door and find three special disks inside.
Take the disks and return to the Mechanic in the shelter.


You'll inform the Mechanic that the captain is dead and the scientist won't tell you anything (he's waiting for the APC to complete the mission).
The Mechanic will update the mission and tell you to collect new electronics and bring them to him.


At the same time, you'll be given four missions to complete on the Icebreaker.
Search for items and equipment. These reward a lot of money and good gear.
 

You need to find 10 special Noobie Shield potassium iodide tablets.

They often spawn on the Icebreaker in various rooms at medical spawn locations.

Can be done over several raids.

tour.name: Tour
tour.html:
Everything starts with training. You need to escape from the Ground Zero map.

You spawn on a modified Ground Zero map. There will be no players on this map.

Get up from the floor and look around — hints are active for you. Collect items around you.

Medical supplies, food, weapons. Carefully inspect tables, crates, and corpses — as well as around the corpses. They have weapons, ammunition, and cassettes for your player.

You don't have to collect items — this is training, and everything you get during this mission will not be carried over to your stash. You will be given starting items separately after completing this mission.

It is IMPOSSIBLE to die in this mission.

When you have collected everything you need in the starting location, move further down the corridor — Scavs will be waiting for you there (these are hostile bots that will shoot at you).

Kill them. Move further toward the street.

The path to the exit from the location:

Path to the exit from Ground Zero. 1.
Path to the exit from Ground Zero. 1.
Path to the exit from Ground Zero. 2
Path to the exit from Ground Zero. 2

Path to the exit from Ground Zero. 3
Path to the exit from Ground Zero. 3
Path to the exit from Ground Zero. 4
Path to the exit from Ground Zero. 4

Reach the very end of the fence and exit the location.
========================

After exiting, you need to talk to Therapist and pay her 250,000 rubles. Sell excess items or collect them as a Scav. You will unlock Streets of Tarkov (passage to this map).

Then talk to Ragman. He will give you a task to go to the Interchange map and explore it. There will already be players here.
In practice, you just need to extract alive from the location, or die 3 times.

Use our convenient maps.

Find exits on the Interchange map

After extracting, talk to Ragman again. He will unlock a new trader for you — Skier.

========================

Talk to Skier. He will give you a task to find 5 items from the Construction Materials category in raid. They can be found on any available location. We recommend Interchange — there are construction material stores there.

Find spawn locations for the required items

You will also unlock an additional task and the Customs map. Go to this map and look for exits.

Find exits from Customs

Move carefully; there will be player opponents here. Collect items, construction materials, kill bots. Exit the location.

Progress through 3 deaths also works.

========================

After surviving on Customs, return to Skier and he will unlock some exits/transitions for you, including to Factory.

When you hand over the Construction Materials, additional locations and transitions will also become available to you.

========================

The next trader that will be unlocked for you is Mechanic. Visit him and talk to take new quests and tasks.

He will give you the following task — go to the Factory map, then survive and extract. Or die 3 times.

Find exits on the Factory map

Additionally, Mechanic will ask you to bring him Scav weapons. He will also unlock additional exits/transitions.

========================

After surviving on Factory, talk to Mechanic again. He will unlock the Woods map for you and give you a task to go there.

In addition to standard survival (or 3 deaths), you will need to kill 3 any targets on this map. Extract after killing them.

Find exits from the Woods map

========================

After completing the quest on the Woods map, go and talk to Skier. He will give you directions to the Shoreline map.

Go to the Port, but do not approach the sniper towers near the Port (warning signs).

Find the place you need to approach

Spot near the checkpoint
Spot near the checkpoint
The spot you need to approach in order to mark the Port.
The spot you need to approach in order to mark the Port.

There, next to the bus, there will be a tower. Under the tower there will be a control panel; press it and the subtask will update. Now you need to talk to the traders in your hideout.

Same marker as above

The way to contact the military is located under the guard tower.
The way to contact the military is located under the guard tower.

========================

You need to find out how to get out of Tarkov.

========================

After talking to the traders, you will learn from Mechanic that you need to hand him 8000 dollars (he will unlock Lighthouse for you).

And also go on a raid to the Shoreline map and successfully survive. Or die 3 times.

Getting such a huge sum of money will be difficult, but Peacekeeper has been unlocked for you (without a quest, but you can sell items and gear for dollars).

========================

At the moment, you may have accumulated 3 goals:

Ensure access to the Reserve map — you need to bring Prapor 5 PMC dog tags from raid.

Ensure access to the Lighthouse map — you need to pay Mechanic 8000 dollars.

Ensure access to Streets of Tarkov (you already got it since you paid Therapist earlier).

========================

When you find

TerraGroup Labs access keycard
, you will get a new task. In this case, you need to enter the Laboratory location.

As optional tasks, you will need to find the entrances to the Laboratory on the Factory and Streets of Tarkov maps.

Find the entrance to the Laboratory on Factory

Find the entrance to the Laboratory on Streets of Tarkov

On the Laboratory territory, your quest will update.

You need to inspect the top managers' offices. Inspect the server room and the retreat point in the drain.

Find locations on the Laboratory map

Server room for Tour
Server room for Tour

Surviving and extracting from the Laboratory is not required.

========================

After unlocking all locations and exploring the Laboratory, this storyline will be completed. You will unlock permanent access to the Laboratory from your hideout.

falling-skies.name: Falling Skies
falling-skies.html:
This quest becomes available immediately after completing Mechanic’s sub-task for a successful extraction from the Factory map.

Otherwise, you can receive the quest by entering the Woods map and approaching the plane on your own.

First task. You need to go to the Woods map and find the plane.

Find the plane on the Woods map

There are many different items, food, and valuables lying around the plane.

 

Approach the plane, and after receiving the completion notification for the quest, proceed to extract from the location.

Task two.

Talk to the Therapist.

She will give you two tasks — give her 2,000 dollars and find the flash drive.

You may already have the dollars; if not, complete the quest Tour until you unlock Peacemaker. After that, sell items to him for dollars.

 

The flash drive is located on the Shoreline map near the Tunnel extraction.

Flash drive under the car wheel. View from farther away
Flash drive under the car wheel. View from farther away

Flash drive under the car wheel
Flash drive under the car wheel

USB flash drive on the car suspension
USB flash drive on the car suspension

Find the car on the Shoreline map

Hand the flash drive over to Prapor. Wait for some time (possibly a full real-life day).

The flash drive was decrypted in about 1 real hour. Return to Prapor and update the quest.

You need to find the Black Box on the Woods map and bring it to Shoreline.

Find the box in the plane

The box from a distance
The box from a distance
The box up close
The box up close

Then extract from the raid and start a new raid on the Shoreline map.

Head toward the destroyed tunnel, then cross over to the fishermen’s island using the barge. Go into the house and enter the farthest room. Plant the box and return to your Hideout.

Find the planting spot on Shoreline

The required house is reached by crossing the barge.
The required house is reached by crossing the barge.
The place where you need to plant the black box
The place where you need to plant the black box

Your next task is to find various components for Prapor.

Rechargeable battery
x3,

x5, and
Toolset
.

All of these can be found on the Interchange map, but really anywhere. The toolbox can be crafted or traded.

 

After handing over all the items, Prapor will ask you to wait for some time. After waiting, he will tell you to go to the Shoreline map and search the chairman’s house (for example Courtesy Visit) to find a diary with data and a flash drive. Take them and bring them to your Hideout.

Find the required house

A flash drive from afar
A flash drive from afar

One of the flash drive spawn locations. On the plate or nearby.

Transcript. View from a distance
Transcript. View from a distance
Transcript spawn under the mattress
Transcript spawn under the mattress

 

When talking to Prapor, a certain “ticket out of Tarkov” will be mentioned. You need to go to the Woods map again, to the same plane. Find the case in the pilot’s cockpit — on the seat or on the floor. Take it and bring it back to Prapor.

Find the location on the Woods map

The case is inside the plane on the floor to the left of the entrance.
The case is inside the plane on the floor to the left of the entrance.
The case is shaped like a long item.
The case is shaped like a long item.

 

After you bring the case to Prapor, you will have a choice — give the case to him as you agreed earlier, or keep it for yourself. THIS IS AN IMPORTANT CHOICE!

Each choice gives you an achievement, and the other one cannot be obtained in this playthrough.

“Man of His Word” – if you give the case to Prapor
“Just business” – if you kept the case.

 

ATTENTION! This choice affects which achievements you can earn. You can choose any outcome—you will not lock yourself out from completing any of the Storylines. However, the storylines related to Prapor The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen" and The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor" will be more difficult if you kept the case for yourself. If you gave the case to Prapor, you will need to complete the Lightkeeper questline, but the Prapor endings The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen" and The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor" will be easier.

 

Both choices may affect the next storyline The Ticket. You will need to build Recon Center level 1.

The storyline is complete.

the-ticket.name: The Ticket
the-ticket.html:
ATTENTION! We have created separate quests for completing each specific ending. Find them via search on the website, in the quest map, or click the links below:

The Ticket. Kerman. "Savior", The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen" The Ticket. Lightkeeper. "Stay in Tarkov" The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor"

 

This storyline quest begins when you install Intelligence Center level 1.

Kerman – the cat hacker – will contact you. The dialogue will depend on your decisions in Falling Skies.

 

Quest Falling Skies only affects the difficulty of passing through some storylines.

This means that if you give the case to Prapor, to complete The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor" you will need to unlock the Lightkeeper, but in this case you will have to pay Prapor 300 million rubles, not 500 million rubles.

In any case, you will be able to achieve any ending; the case only affects the difficulty of the Prapor-based endings.

 

In this main storyline quest you will have 4 endings.

These are literally 4 different paths with completely different approaches.

We created 4 separate sub-quests with the names of the NPCs that work with you.

Here we outline them briefly, but you can always open those quests and study them in detail.

==========

The best ending is achieved by choosing Kerman The Ticket. Kerman. "Savior".
This is the same hacker-cat you communicate with via the laptop in your Hideout.
Give the case to Prapor and later return it through the Lightkeeper.

While completing his tasks, you will learn a lot about TerraGroup.
You must always cooperate with him and help in every way. Complete ALL storyline chains.

To achieve the best ending, you must gather all incriminating evidence for his final quest.
This will help you: Notes for completing the quest 100% Ticket for Kerman

Ending “Savior”.
You collected the evidence, successfully left Tarkov, and can now fight TerraGroup.

==========

The medium, neutral ending belongs to Prapor The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor", if after opening the case you immediately refuse Kerman’s help.
In this scenario, the payment required will depend on whether you gave the case to Prapor in Falling Skies or not.

If you gave the case to Prapor, you must unlock the Lightkeeper and then pay Prapor 300 million rubles.
If you kept the case, you do NOT need to unlock the Lightkeeper, the story progresses faster, but you must pay 500 million rubles.
After paying, you must complete additional tasks — we are gathering data.

Ending “Survivor”.
You successfully left Tarkov, but TerraGroup remains unpunished.
But you don’t care, right?

==========

Neutral-bad ending via the Lightkeeper The Ticket. Lightkeeper. "Stay in Tarkov". You can get this if you refuse to collect ALL the compromising materials for Kerman. You need to follow Kerman's path, but then refuse to collect all the compromising materials. Collect a little and refuse to collect it completely.

In Falling Skies you must give the case to Prapor, and then unlock the Lightkeeper through Network Provider - Part 1.
This will be a long quest chain through the Lightkeeper.
You will need to kill and gather items. Data will be updated.

Ending “Debtor”.
You successfully left Tark… Oh, wait—no.
In this ending, due to your debts to the Lightkeeper, you cannot leave Tarkov.
When attempting to depart by boat, you are brought back to repay your debts.

==========

Bad ending with Prapor, but via Kerman The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen". We follow the path of cooperation with Kerman, but at the very last moment when we are required to collect compromising materials on TerraGroup, we immediately refuse to collect them. Then we go to Prapor and receive expensive tasks from him, and in the end we need to collect 1 million dollars.

The "Fallen" ending.

Most likely, due to the "Bio-weapon" in this choice, this ending is considered not very good. We get shot and remain in Tarkov, while TerraGroup conquers the world.

==========

Another note spawn location in the same camp.
Another note spawn location in the same camp.

Talk to Kerman. He will give you a lead on the Lighthouse Keeper.

 

Now you need to open access to the Keeper. To activate quest Network Provider - Part 1, Fence reputation above 1.0 is required.

 

After completing the quest chain to open the Keeper and specifically this quest Getting Acquainted, you must come to the Keeper on the Lighthouse map and talk about the task (by default the third dialogue line is “I want to discuss something”).

The Keeper will tell you that he needs three

TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials
. Do not take additional tasks if you plan to complete only the storyline.

The plot will not update (at the time of writing the guide). This dialogue repeats many times (bug), so talk only once and leave. Return to your Hideout. Complete the Mechanic's quest about the Keeper. After that the plot will update (you may need to restart the game).

TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials
you can simply buy on the Flea Market or find them on the Laboratory location.

Take the documents into your secure container and go to the Lighthouse map again.

 

Give the documents to the Keeper and receive a new task.

You need to use a yellow flare on the Interchange map near the central entrance to the Ultra mall. You need to run around and kill any targets on this map.

Buy

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)
and put it in the special slot. Then get ready for a raid on the Interchange map; we recommend not using a suppressor, because noise will bring both PMCs and Scavs — it will be easier for you. Load into the map and launch the flare into the air near the central entrance to the Ultra mall.

Find the location on the Interchange map

The task will update.

Now you need to kill any targets in the amount of 15 units. Bots, PMCs — any. You must not die or leave the map — one attempt. Or restart the mission.

Complete this task and return to the Keeper again to hand it in.

 

Talk to him and receive the quest case. Free up the special slot!

 

Next you will need to open the case.

 

Kerman will ask you to contact the Mechanic to open the case. The Mechanic will tell you to find the “Experimental Signal Jammer” in the Laboratory.

The signal jammer spawn location is in the lecture hall. You can find it on the tables in the audience seats, as well as on the podium in front of the screen.

Find the lecture hall on the map

Signal suppressor in the lecture hall
Signal suppressor in the lecture hall

 

Another spawn location is in the new area among medical equipment on a table.

Find another spawn location

Signal suppressor on a new area
Signal suppressor on a new area

 

Another signal jammer can be found on tables on level 2.

Find another spawn location

Signal suppressor on tables in the center
Signal suppressor on tables in the center

 

After finding the “Signal Jammer”, return to the Mechanic and talk to him. He will give further instructions and update the task.

You will be given a craft at the Workbench; the lock in the case will take more than two days to open.

 

After opening, you will receive the case in your stash (free up space, there are many items). Open it and receive:

A lot of Euros

Random keycard

Special RFID card in the name of Kruglov — our quest item. Also, your messages will update; study what they send you.

 

After that, talk to Kerman.
 

Of course, choose cooperation with Kerman, then several tasks will be added.

You need to find the “RFID Card Encryption Device”.

Find the “Master Pass for the Laboratory”.

Activate the RFID card from the case in Kruglov's name.

 

To do this you need to get access to Streets of Tarkov (according to the storyline Tour, you most likely have it).

Find Kruglov's apartment on Streets of Tarkov.

Have access to the Laboratory map (you most likely have it too).

Visit Kruglov's office on the Laboratory map (the office is known, there will be a link to the map below).

Optional — you need to have Solar Power in the Hideout. At this stage it is an optional task.

Find the “Clean RFID Card”.

 

A new craft will be opened for you.

 

You can find the Master Pass in the new Kruglov room inside the safe.

Find the room on the Laboratory map

To enter you need

TerraGroup Labs access keycard
and necessarily at least 2 charges of
TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
. One charge to enter the room, the second charge to open the safe.

Inside the safe there will be the Pass. It is a quest item. If you die, you will need to take it again. Take the Pass and bring it to the Hideout, transfer it to your inventory through the tasks section — this way it will not be lost or destroyed.

 

You can find the “Clean RFID Card” in marked rooms with some chance.

It was definitely found in this room

Dorm room 314 marked key

 

If you give up searching for the “RFID Card Encryption Device” or the quest fails (if you walk around the Laboratory a lot without success), you will receive a message that you need to talk to the Mechanic. After talking to him, a timer will start.

Important clarification about quest failure. To move the quest from a dead point, you need to survive 3 raids in a row on the Laboratory map for 10+ minutes. It is possible that surviving on any location counts, but exact information is only about the Laboratory.

After about 30 hours of waiting, talk to the Mechanic again. He will tell you that to help you will need 40x

Physical Bitcoin
. You can look for them or exchange them with the Mechanic once every 2 hours.

Trader

Items

Result item

Trader
Items
Tetriz
x2

x2
Result item
0.2BTC

Restriction: 1 items

 

After you have found the required number of Bitcoins, give them to the Mechanic and immediately receive from him the Electronics key with 20 charges. This key will give access to the apartment on Streets of Tarkov. If you lose the key, it can be bartered for 1 Bitcoin.

Go to the Streets of Tarkov location to the building where the transition to the Laboratory is located. Go inside, open the door with the received key, go inside through the hallway into the room; under the table there will be the needed encryptor.

Find the room on the Streets of Tarkov map

Path to the required apartment Electronics 1
Path to the required apartment Electronics 1
Path to the required apartment Electronics 2
Path to the required apartment Electronics 2

The needed apartment is inside the building, on the right.
The needed apartment is inside the building, on the right.
Inside the room under the table
Inside the room under the table

The encoder up close under the table
The encoder up close under the table

Take it into your secure container and leave the location. In the Hideout, use the Intelligence Center to craft the activated key for the quest. The craft will take more than 48 hours; make sure the fuel does not run out!

 

After crafting, you need to use the received keycard on the Shoreline map, where we have already been for the Tour quest.

Find the required location on the Shoreline map

Use the keycard and the task status will change. Exit the map to the Hideout and talk to Kerman.

 

Now you need to collect dirt on the TerraGroup company. You most likely have already collected part of it.

You need to find 8 major dirt and 36 minor dirt.

Major dirt is completed storyline quests.

Minor dirt is additional notes, tapes, and blueprint books. They can be found during other storylines. The found notes may affect the ending. If you collect all 36 items, you will receive an achievement.

Minor dirt can be found in this article Notes for completing the quest 100% Ticket for Kerman

 

We have written the storylines to complete below.

Tour
Falling Skies
They Are Already Here
Batya
Accidental Witness

Blue Fire

The Unheard

The Labyrinth
Boreas

 

After collecting all the dirt (completing the storylines and collecting all/part of the notes), talk to Kerman and tell him that everything has been collected. Kerman will tell you that your map had incorrect hash codes. After that he says you need to wait until his courier contacts you.

After that, in messages, take the special container “Alpha-1”.

 

After about 48 hours of real time, Fence will contact you. After talking to him, he will say that he does not trust you (if Fence reputation is insufficient). And he will demand that you raise reputation with him to 4.0. You can raise reputation with successful Scav raids, killing PMCs as a Scav, using co-op extracts (PMC + Scav), also using the paid extract as a PMC. And daily tasks from this trader.

 

After raising Fence reputation to 4.0 and above, you will receive a new task. You need to exit together with a Scav at a co-op extract on the Woods and Reserve maps (in PVP; in PVE mode you need to kill PMCs on these maps).

For this you need to dress as a PMC, go to the required location, wait until the timer is 25 minutes or less and look for player Scavs. Negotiate with them in VOIP, offer various valuables as a reward (you can bring them with you).

Find the co-op extract on the Woods map
Find the co-op extract on the Reserve map


After this subtask, you will need to raise reputation with the BTR Driver. You can find him on the Woods map and on Streets of Tarkov.
Complete quests from this line A Helping Hand for the BTR Driver and for Prapor. If one of the tasks does not update, then complete the Skier quest from the adjacent quest branch. In any case, focus on helping the BTR Driver up to The Price of Independence

 

After completing the BTR Driver quest line, your task will update. You will be required to install Solar Power level 1. This is a rather expensive Hideout module. At minimum you will need to find

Advanced current converter
. It can only be found on the Laboratory map, or obtained as a reward for quest Trouble in the Big City.

 

After building the module, you will need to set up the production of an RFID card with Kerman's hash codes. Production takes about 12 hours. Watch your fuel in the Hideout!

 

After producing this card, you can enter the Terminal.

WARNING! Take either the worst and cheapest weapon and gear, and then pick up good gear from corpses on the Terminal map. Or take the best (with class 6 protection and eye protection, preferably with NVG). After entering the Terminal, everything will be taken from you. You will need to collect food, medications, and gear in the house where you will be left after entering the map. Later, in the Arsenal, you can retrieve your gear.

WARNING! If you die in the Terminal territory, you will have access to replay, but Kruglov's keycard will need to be crafted each time for 12 hours. Look for “Clean RFID Card” as much as possible

 

Approach the intercom on the Shoreline map and use the keycard.

Then a cutscene will start and you will enter the Terminal.

BE SURE TO TAKE THE “Alpha-1” CONTAINER WITH YOU. Even if you die, it will return to you in messages.

 

This is the best ending of all storylines. “Savior”

A spawn location for the jammer is in the lecture hall. It can be found on tables in the audience area, as well as on the lectern in front of the screen.

You can find the lecture hall on the map

Signal suppressor in the lecture hall
Signal suppressor in the lecture hall

Another spawn location is in the new territory among medical equipment on a table.

Find another spawn location

Signal suppressor on a new area
Signal suppressor on a new area

Another signal jammer can be found on tables on level 2.

Find another spawn location

Signal suppressor on tables in the center
Signal suppressor on tables in the center

After finding the "Signal Jammer," return to the Mechanic and talk to him. He will give further instructions and update the quest.

You will receive a craft recipe for the Workbench; it will take over two days to unlock the case.

After opening it, you will receive the case in your stash (make room, it contains many items). Open it and receive:

A lot of Euros
A random keycard
A special RFID card in the name of Kruglov – our quest item. Your mail will also update; examine what was sent to you.

After this, talk to Kerman.

Of course, choose to cooperate with Kerman, and several tasks will be added.

You need to find the "RFID Card Encryption Device."
Find the "Laboratory Master Key"
Activate the RFID card from the case in the name of Kruglov.

For this, you need:

Access to Streets of Tarkov (through the story quest "Tour," you most likely have it)
Find Kruglov's apartment on Streets of Tarkov
Have access to the Laboratory map (you most likely have it too)
Visit Kruglov's office on the Laboratory map (the office is known; a map link will be below)
Optional – need to have a Solar Panel in the shelter. Not a mandatory quest at this stage.
Find a "Clean RFID Card"

A new craft will be unlocked for you.

You can find the Master Key in Kruglov's new room inside a safe.

Find the room on the Laboratory map

Entry requires

TerraGroup Labs access keycard
and at least 2 charges of
TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
. One charge to enter the room, the second to open the safe.

The safe contains the Keycard. This is a quest item. If you die, you will need to retrieve it again. Take the Keycard and bring it to the shelter, transfer it to your inventory through the quests tab – this way it won't be lost or destroyed.

You can find the "Clean RFID Card" in marked rooms with some chance.

It has been definitively found in this room:

Dorm room 314 marked key

If you give up searching for the "RFID Card Encryption Device" or the quest fails (if you spend a lot of time in the Laboratory without success), you will be prompted to talk to the Mechanic. Talking to him will start a timer.

Important clarification about quest failure. To move the quest forward from a dead point, you need to survive in a raid on the Laboratory map for 10+ minutes, 3 times in a row. It might be possible to survive on any location, but confirmed information exists only for the Laboratory.

Approximately after 30 hours of waiting, talk to the Mechanic again. He will inform you that he needs 40x

Physical Bitcoin
to help. You can search for them or exchange them with the Mechanic every 2 hours.

Go to the Streets of Tarkov location, to the house where the transition to the Laboratory is. Go inside, open the door with the received key, enter through the hallway into a room. The needed encoder will be under a desk.

Now you need to collect compromising materials on the TerraGroup company. You have probably already collected some of it.

You need to find 8 pieces of major compromising materials and 32 pieces of minor compromising materials.

 

According to this guide, THE LIGHTKEEPER MUST BE OPENED.

Collect a few compromising materials and then refuse to continue collecting further.

You will learn that none of the traders can help you, and then you need to go to the Lightkeeper.

boreas.html:
To start the storyline, you need Intelligence Center level 3.

Alternatively, find a special poster. At minimum, it is on Streets of Tarkov and Epicenter.

The Prapor walkthrough will depend on the outcome of Falling Skies. It will be easier and cheaper to complete this branch if you are on good terms with him.

If you are friends with the APC driver and you have completed The Price of Independence, it will be easier.
To go to the Icebreaker location, you need

Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit
. To leave the Icebreaker location, you will need 2,500 euros.

On the Icebreaker location, collect in advance: 3 UltraLink, 4 Memento, 2 Gigachad. These need to be taken out of the raid to complete the story later.

 

Paradigm Shipping 

The poster can be purchased at the Flea Market

Find the poster on Streets of Tarkov.

The poster for the start of the plot
The poster for the start of the plot

poster on Streets

==========================

 

Via Intelligence Center level 3:

Approach the radio in the shelter and use it. Or simply talk to the traders.

 

The task will update, and you will need to talk to the Mechanic.

After the conversation, you need to go to the Woods map. Take

Toolset
with you.

 

Move to the Scav bunker in the north of the map.

Approach the tower and start repairing for 10 seconds.

Find the tower to repair

After that, your kit will disappear, and you can exit the location and talk to the Mechanic.

 

After the conversation, you need to go to the Lighthouse map, to the Rogue base in the Rail Yard. There will be a document on the table. Take it, read it, and go to the exit.

Find the depot

Entrance to the desired depot
Entrance to the desired depot
Folder inside the depot on the table
Folder inside the depot on the table

 

Hand the document over to the Mechanic and talk to him.

After the conversation, you need to talk to Prapor.

=====================

DON'T BE RUDE TO HIM. He may give you additional tasks, either because of your bad attitude. For example, you may need to kill 30 targets on the Reserve map or find x3

Military power filter
in a raid.

If you have these quests, after killing 30 targets, you will need to approach the transition to the Woods location and use

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)

Find the desired location on the map

You do not need to transition. Return home and talk to Prapor

=====================

 

He will tell you to go to the Reserve map and search for AMG-10 oil.

According to the lead, it is located either on the parade ground, in the basements, or near the helicopter. Also in the hangars. We will mark the exact locations with markers and screenshots.

 

Find the locations on the Reserve map

Spawn near the helicopter.

Reserve oil on the map near the helicopter in the center of the parade ground
Reserve oil on the map near the helicopter in the center of the parade ground

 

Spawn under the training building.

Oil in the warehouse under the textbook
Oil in the warehouse under the textbook

AMG-10 oil in the warehouse under the training building. Another spawn location.
AMG-10 oil in the warehouse under the training building. Another spawn location.

 

Spawn inside the helicopter.

AMG-10 in the helicopter.
AMG-10 in the helicopter.

 

Spawn inside the helicopter on the box

AMG-10 on the box inside the helicopter.
AMG-10 on the box inside the helicopter.

 

After finding the oil, Prapor will tell you that he cannot take you to the Icebreaker, but he can take you out from there. You will need

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Green)
or
RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)
. We are clarifying. Also, bring 2,500 euros with you.

 

After this, go and find the BTR Driver.

You may need to complete his quests to increase reputation.

Find BTR Driver stops on the Woods map

Find BTR Driver stops on the Streets of Tarkov map

 

If you have completed The Price of Independence, you will not need to do the next quest. However, you will need to start a new raid to talk to the Driver.

===============

He will tell you to kill 10 any targets on the smugglers' territory.

On Shoreline and Interchange.

Find the required location on Shoreline

Find the required location on Interchange

===============

If you chose the BTR Driver storyline ending for Skier Choose your friends wisely, you will need to do several difficult tasks.

First task:

You need to find and bring 200x

7.62x54mm R BT gzh
to the BTR Driver.

This is extremely difficult to do in PvP, as the ammunition cannot be placed into a secure container. Find the ammo on the Reserve map.

Second, an extremely rare and unclear task:

You need to find Skier's documents on the Customs map.

Find the documents to burn

Skier's Documents.
Skier's Documents.

After finding them, you need to burn them in any burning barrel. The nearest one is inside the "skeleton" – the new construction building.

Barrel for burning documents
Barrel for burning documents

After this, you will be given a quest to "kill 15 any targets on the smugglers' territory."

On Shoreline and Interchange.

Find the required location on Shoreline

Find the required location on Interchange

After that, follow the standard path below.

===============

 

Talk to the Mechanic and tell him you are ready and have found transport.

 

He will send you to Shoreline, to the Transition point.

Find the boat for the transition to Icebreaker

 

Take

Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit
, 2,500 euros, and
RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Green)
.

 

Take the best gear and weapons. As many good rounds and medical supplies as possible. Some food. Take a flashlight or night vision goggles. It's dark in some areas.

According to rumors,

Toolset
will be needed. Take it just in case.

 

=============

Open all markers on the Icebreaker map at once

The raid gives you 40 minutes in total.

Navigating the map is quite difficult at the moment, but we are already drawing it.

Progression is available in a semi-corridor format. Move forward and open doors.

Be careful, as Rogues and Black Division are on the Icebreaker. They have a lot of health, good armor, as well as excellent weapons and ammo.

Along the way you will find valuable items, food, and medical supplies.

 

After spawning on the Icebreaker, it will be night. Behind the nearest door you will find

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Green)
and various tools.

Immediately run left along the edge of the deck and open the airtight door, then the second door — enemies may be straight ahead in the corridor.

Turn left, then into the first cabin on the right, and then into the next room inside it — then left again. There you will find a dead engineer with a map in his left hand.

Find the keycard on the Icebreaker map
